Newly joined and was referred by 111 to get help here. The practice called to set an appointment after the referral from nhs, I waited all day but the clinician Alison Jackson never rang. So I called to chase and find out if the call was still taking place - they said yes. Then I get a text message saying I missed the appointment even though I did not. I called back and spoke to the most rude, insensitive receptionist. She first said I was on the list and because I questioned why she was speaking to me so rudely she put me on hold and then came back to say Alison Jackson won’t be calling me today because she’s finished for day and to wait til tomorrow. I relayed that I desperately needed to speak to someone but the receptionist did not care and continued to speak rudely. I put the phone down with no appointment or help, but a wasted day waiting for a phone call for medical assistance. Horrendous practice, if you can avoid, you should. I am now formally complaining about this practice to an external regulator. Shocking these people work in care profession.",null,[0,240]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURiNkozcFd3EAE!2m1!1s0x0:0xd67bc3aa27204f36!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgIDb6J3pWw%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURiNkozcFd3EAE&t=1&entityid=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURiNkozcFd3Ei0KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJRGI2SjNwMndFEhJDZ3NJaG91dnRRWVFzSjZWWXcaLAoWQ0lITTBvZ0tFSUNBZ0lEYjZKM3BPdxISQ2dzSWhvdXZ0UVlRc0o2Vll3IhIJAAAAAAAAAAARNk8gJ6rDe9YqEkNnc0lob3V2dFFZUXNKNlZZdw&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwih1_6H27KTAxU-IGMBHTC5D5MQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,1]]]],"0ahUKEwih1_6H27KTAxU-IGMBHTC5D5MQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSemQ0UWtkMlFWOWZSV2hDVFcxRU1qRTVRbWhXZDJscFkybE1hMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpUUlVOaWRrVkZZVGhCV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUROOGVyUzJBRRAB",["0x0:0xd67bc3aa27204f36",null,1706014044782306,1706014044782306,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113364467039631697311/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Dan Squires","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKX0YX-wT6ujgncH8NQkjR8t8so-Xv_Qw1gPbLNf-bWaPr6aw=s120-c-rp-mo-ba3-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113364467039631697311?hl=en"],"113364467039631697311",null,47,0,null,[1,5,1],8,["Local Guide · 47 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwih1_6H27KTAxU-IGMBHTC5D5MQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"2 years ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[4],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Always a positive experience, all staff exceptionally helpful and friendly.
